notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
You have less than nine poison counters.
description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each creature and giving each opponent ten poison counters, and you one poison counter.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.
